notablePrerequisites: Ob Nixilis has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ob Nixilis using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat.
